title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 安全预防 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）
meta: 主题语境：安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）　|　核心词汇：smoke　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 smoke 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the farmer ① saw the smoke that no child in the field would have counted, and he said the seeing was the whole of the autumn. The ② smoke, meaning the fume itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed uncounted in the book; smoke, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ sort of smoke in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ smoke at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Smoke, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the farmer said the counting is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the smoke was the whole of the matter, meaning the warning and not the fume. The ⑥ smoke, meaning the warning and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; smoke, he said, is either something you see or the only word that means both fume and a warning. He said the warning is the part they remember.

By 1980 the ⑦ smoke had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ smoke of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of counting; smoke, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ smoke I remember is the smoke counted in the almanac, which closed in 1982 and is still counted as the quietest in the field. ⑩ Smoke, my mother said in 1984, is the only thing that improves by being counted; all smoke, she said, is a warning that has agreed to look like fume. She said the warning was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 烟（指田垄里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 烟（指那缕烟本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：see the smoke 望见这一缕烟
D. n. 烟（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 烟之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的烟之事）
F. n. 烟（指农事历里写到、被清点的那一缕）
G. n. 烟、警讯（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 警讯（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: saw the smoke that no child in the field would have counted

the smoke at the far fence

answers.why: see the smoke 意为“望见这一缕烟”，1975 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯清点的一缕烟做了一遍。
smoke 意为“烟”，指那缕烟本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被清点。
smoke 意为“烟”，指田垄里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
smoke 意为“烟”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
smoke 意为“烟、警讯”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这缕警讯就是那件事的全部。
smoke 意为“警讯”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那缕烟，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
smoke 意为“烟”，指农事历里写到、被清点的那一缕，到 1980 年这一缕成了农事历里的一行。
smoke 意为“烟之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的烟之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的清点。
smoke 意为“烟”，我记得的是农事历里清点过的那一缕，1982 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一缕。
smoke 为抽象总称，母亲 1984 年说，烟是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的烟。
